scope: Existing mor-test public Nginx/Gateway/BFF/Risk/Platform chain; no API interception or synthetic trusted headers

rateLimitObservation.detail: Rapid repeated browser navigation exhausted an existing list-read Guard. The version-save POST succeeded with 200, followed by three list GET 429 responses. After the existing refill window, a fresh login verified the saved current version and completed Back/delete checks without another save. No rate policy was changed.

HTTP status is checked from the response, not a required body status member.
Ant Design two-character button accessible labels include whitespace.
Final readonly account audit uses t_user_account/CLOSED, not t_account/DELETED.
